name: frisian-asr-streaming-0.6b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (config.json max_position_embeddings 5000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Full fine-tune of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (0.6B, NeMo cache-aware FastConformer-RNNT) on ~40h of Frisian (West Frisian, fy-NL) from LokaalHub/frisian-asr-cv22, conditioned on the nl-NL prompt slot because Frisian is not one of the base's 40 locales. Base-model WER on the same held-out set was measured with the same evaluator - 82.87% at 80ms and 81.69% at 1120ms versus 20.36% and 18.01% here - so the comparison IS same-harness, which is rarer than it should be; but the base cannot transcribe Frisian under any prompt, so the delta mostly measures 'adaptation to a language the base never had'. The card is explicit about the cost: fine-tuning on Frisian-only with no multilingual replay catastrophically forgets the other 39 locales, so this is a dedicated monolingual model and NOT a drop-in replacement for the base. Raw WER (casing/punctuation count), 3,173 speaker- and sentence-disjoint clips. Architecture fields are null because the base catalog record does not carry them, not because the model keeps a different config. Licence openmdw-1.1 (card field 'other'), repo created 2026-06-09.

benchmarks.name: Raw WER, Frisian (fy) test, 80 ms streaming
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Language | Base Model WER | Fine-tuned WER | Relative Improvement |': 'Frisian (nl-NL) | 82.87% | 20.36% | 75.4%'. Cache-aware streaming at att_context_size=[56,0] (80 ms), 3,173 held-out clips, speaker- and sentence-disjoint, same evaluation for both models. Raw WER - casing and punctuation count as errors. CAVEAT printed on the card: Frisian is not one of the base's 40 locales, so the base cannot transcribe it at all; the gap is mostly new-language coverage rather than a delta between two working systems.

benchmarks.name: Raw WER, Frisian (fy) test, 1120 ms streaming
benchmarks.config: Same card table at att_context_size=[56,13] (1120 ms): base 81.69% vs fine-tuned 18.01%, same 3,173-clip disjoint test set. Raw WER. The card notes the base's own published Dutch nl-NL WER is 11.46% at 1120 ms and that this model fully fine-tuned on Frisian-only data, forgetting the other 39 locales - a dedicated monolingual model, not a drop-in replacement.
